name: Skild AI
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Skild AI is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Skild AI is a privately held robotics software company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $1.4 billion Series C round announced on January 14, 2026, valued the company at more than $14 billion.

Founded in 2023 and based in Pittsburgh, Skild AI develops the Skild Brain, an AI model designed to control robots of many different types. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Skild AI did not announce its Series B; the valuation and amount shown are as reported by TechCrunch.
round_notes: In September 2026, Skild AI said it had passed $100 million in annual recurring revenue; that figure is the company's own.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: SoftBank led the Series C, with participation from Nvidia's venture arm, Macquarie Capital, 1789 Capital and Bezos Expeditions. SoftBank was also reported to have anchored the Series B. Lightspeed Venture Partners, Coatue, SoftBank and Bezos Expeditions led the Series A, joined by Felicis, Sequoia Capital, Menlo Ventures, General Catalyst, Carnegie Mellon University and Amazon's Industrial Innovation Fund.
spv_sentence: SEC filings show one special purpose vehicle formed to invest in Skild AI, organized in 2025.
sources: Sources: Skild AI's Series A announcement and its September 2026 update; TechCrunch reports dated January 14, 2026 and December 8, 2025; reporting by Bloomberg (2025); and SEC Form D filings.
